scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs dist
scripts.build:sites: rimraf dist dist-sites-ssr && tsc -b && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/sites-build.log VITE_THEME=nextgen vite build --config vite.sites.config.ts && VITE_THEME=nextgen vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-sites-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs dist/client dist-sites-ssr --worker-campaign-routing
scripts.build:classic: tsc -b && VITE_THEME=classic vite build --outDir dist-classic && VITE_THEME=classic vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-classic-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs dist-classic
scripts.build:nextgen: tsc -b && VITE_THEME=nextgen vite build --outDir dist-nextgen && VITE_THEME=nextgen vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-nextgen-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs dist-nextgen
